targetText: While in the Roman empire the marriage and birthrate were permitted to decline more and more, the Jews maintained far different customs.
summary: Examining family and gender relations from ancient Judea and Rome into early Christianity, Bebel demonstrates how Christian asceticism disparaged sexuality and codified female submission to patriarchal authority, failing to emancipate women from social and domestic servitude.
